description: How Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II - The Sith Lords sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Mods that ship a TSLPatcher.exe change the game's data in place and are not plain file drops; run them yourself.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
